Licence texts that scripts/make-dist.sh copies into dist/Licenses/python/ for Studio
packages whose wheels ship no licence file (THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md, section 4,
"none in wheel"):

ctranslate2-4.9.0-LICENSE.txt  MIT, verbatim from the upstream repository at the release tag:
                               https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenNMT/CTranslate2/v4.9.0/LICENSE
Apache-2.0.txt                 the Apache License 2.0 text, verbatim (copied from the
                               huggingface_hub 2.4.0 wheel's licences folder); used for
                               flatbuffers (Google) and tokenizers (Hugging Face), whose
                               metadata declare Apache-2.0

onnxruntime ships its own LICENSE inside the package folder, and jukeoke-studio is this
project's own code (LICENSE at the repository root).
